name_zh: 坦桑尼亚·朱利叶斯·尼雷尔：乌贾马非洲社会主义与教师国家
name_en: Tanzania Julius Nyerere: Ujamaa African Socialism & Teacher Nation
description_zh: 朱利叶斯·尼雷尔 (1922-1999) 坦桑尼亚首任总统 (1964-1985)，乌贾马村庄化运动推行非洲社会主义，斯瓦希里语统一民族，自愿退位权力和平交接，被誉为教师总统。
description_en: Julius Nyerere (1922-1999) Tanzania first President (1964-1985), Ujamaa villagization implemented African socialism, Swahili unified nation, voluntarily retired peaceful power transfer, hailed as Teacher President.
reason_zh: 尼雷尔代表非洲社会主义本土化实践的最高峰，展示了教师身份如何为政治权力提供道德正当性，其自愿退位打破非洲终身制惯例，乌贾马虽经济失败但文化遗产永存。
reason_en: Nyerere represents African socialism indigenization practice peak, demonstrating how teacher identity provides moral legitimacy for political power, his voluntary retirement breaking African lifetime rule precedent, Ujamaa though economically failed leaves enduring cultural legacy.
steps_zh: 研究尼雷尔早年爱丁堡大学教育与教师身份
分析1967年阿鲁沙宣言与乌贾马村庄化运动
探讨斯瓦希里语国家语言推广与民族融合
评估1985年自愿退位与姆维尼接任和平交接
总结乌贾马非洲社会主义教师国家对非洲政治伦理的永恒贡献
steps_en: Study Nyerere early Edinburgh University education and teacher identity
Analyze 1967 Arusha Declaration and Ujamaa villagization movement
Explore Swahili national language promotion and ethnic fusion
Evaluate 1985 voluntary retirement and Mwinyi succession peaceful handover
Summarize Ujamaa African socialism Teacher Nation eternal contribution to African political ethics
expected_zh: 理解教师道德权威如何支撑社会主义实验与和平交权，掌握语言统一作为民族融合工具的非洲智慧，评估尼雷尔模式对非洲民主化与发展伦理的双重启示。
expected_en: Understand how teacher moral authority supports socialist experiment and peaceful transfer, grasp language unification as ethnic fusion tool African wisdom, evaluate Nyerere model dual lessons for African democratization and development ethics.
case_zh: 1967 阿鲁沙宣言；1970s 乌贾马；1985 退位；1999 逝世。乌贾马非洲社会主义教师范式永存。
case_en: 1967 Arusha Declaration; 1970s Ujamaa; 1985 retirement; 1999 death. Ujamaa African socialism Teacher paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: African socialism; Swahili unification; voluntary retirement; teacher ethics
